title: Pure Fiendsmith
summary: Pure Fiendsmith LIGHT Fiend control build led by Fiendsmith Engraver, Lacrima the Crimson Tears, and the 2025 wave (Fiendsmith Kyrie and Fiendsmith's Rextremende), backed by handtraps and generic staples. Any single LIGHT Fiend climbs through Fiendsmith's Requiem and Fiendsmith's Sequence into multi-negate Fusions and Rank 6 Xyzs while recycling every piece back into the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fiendsmith Engraver discards itself from the hand to search any Fiendsmith Spell or Trap (Fiendsmith's Tract or Fiendsmith's Sanct), and revives itself from the GY by shuffling another LIGHT Fiend from your GY back into the Deck.

Lacrima the Crimson Tears sends any Fiendsmith card from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon, and banishes itself from the GY on the opponent's turn to Special Summon a Fiendsmith Link Monster from your GY or banishment.
Fiendsmith's Tract searches any LIGHT Fiend monster and discards 1 card, while Fiendsmith's Sanct Special Summons a LIGHT Fiend Token that immediately links into Fiendsmith's Requiem.

summary.title: Opening: Fiendsmith Engraver (One-Card Desirae or Caesar)
steps: Discard Fiendsmith Engraver to search Fiendsmith's Tract, then activate Tract to search Lacrima the Crimson Tears and discard a card (or activate Fiendsmith's Sanct for a Fiendsmith Token).
Normal Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears (sending Fiendsmith Kyrie or Fiendsmith in Paradise to the GY) and Link Summon Fiendsmith's Requiem using Lacrima.
Tribute Fiendsmith's Requiem as a Quick Effect to Special Summon a second Fiendsmith Engraver from the Deck, then revive the first Engraver from the GY by shuffling Lacrima or Requiem back.

Take Route A (Rank 6): Overlay the two Level 6 Engravers into D/D/D Wave High King Caesar. Take Route B (Fusion Climb): Link two LIGHT Fiends into Fiendsmith's Sequence and shuffle GY materials back to Fusion Summon Fiendsmith's Desirae, Fiendsmith's Rextremende, or Limited Fiendsmith's Lacrima, then equip Sequence and Requiem from the GY.

summary.title: Link-Equip Scaling
summary.text: Fiendsmith's Requiem, Fiendsmith's Sequence, and Fiendsmith's Agnumday can all equip themselves from the field or GY to a non-Link LIGHT Fiend you control: Requiem grants 600 ATK, Sequence makes the equipped monster untargetable by opponent's card effects, and Agnumday revives a LIGHT Fiend and equips itself to grant piercing battle damage. Both Fiendsmith's Desirae and Fiendsmith's Rextremende scale directly off equippedFiendsmith Links.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Fiendsmith's Desirae (Level 9 Fusion) negates face-up cards on the field as a Quick Effect up to the total Link Rating of Link Monsters equipped to it (negating up to 3 cards when equipped with Fiendsmith's Sequence and Fiendsmith's Requiem), and shuffles another LIGHT Fiend from your GY to send 1 card on the field to the GY when Desirae is sent to the GY.

Fiendsmith's Rextremende (Level 9 Fusion) is unaffected by other card effects while equipped with a Fiendsmith Equip Card, sends a LIGHT Fiend from Deck/Extra Deck to the GY on Summon, and recovers a Fiendsmith card from GY or banishment when sent to the GY.

D/D/D Wave High King Caesar (Rank 6 Xyz made with two Level 6 Fiendsmiths) detaches 1 material to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect that includes Special Summoning a monster (not once per turn).

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Fiendsmith's Tract banishes itself from the GY to Fusion Summon a Fiendsmith Fusion Monster using monsters from your hand or field, and can also use Fiendsmith Link Monsters equipped in your Spell & Trap Zone as Fusion Materials.

Fiendsmith Kyrie halves battle damage and prevents your LIGHT Fiends from being destroyed by battle, and banishes itself from the GY to Fusion Summon a Fiendsmith Fusion Monster using monsters on your field or Fiendsmith monsters equipped in your Spell & Trap Zone.

Fiendsmith in Paradise sends all other cards on the field to the GY while you control a Level 7+ LIGHT Fiend, and banishes itself from the GY when the opponent Special Summons to send a Fiendsmith Fusion/Link (like Desirae) directly from the Extra Deck to the GY.

main: Starter: discards itself to search a Fiendsmith Spell/Trap; revives itself from the GY.
Sends a Fiendsmith card from the Deck to the GY; revives a Fiendsmith Link on their turn.
Searches a LIGHT Fiend and discards; from the GY, Fusion Summons a Fiendsmith.
Quick-Play: a LIGHT Fiend Token for Requiem; sets itself again when a Fiendsmith falls.
Newest Trap: protects LIGHT Fiends in battle; from the GY, Fusion Summons with equipped Links.
Sends every other card on the field to the GY; mills a Fiendsmith when they summon.
extra: Link-1: tributes itself to summon a Fiendsmith from the hand or Deck; equips for 600 ATK.
Link-2: Fusion Summons by shuffling GY materials back; equips for targeting protection.
Link-3: revives a LIGHT Fiend and equips itself to it.
Level 9 Fusion: negates a card for each equipped Link Rating on either turn.
Newest Fusion: unaffected by other cards while equipped; recovers a Fiendsmith card.
Limited. Level 6 Fusion: revives a LIGHT Fiend and shrinks their monsters.
Rank 6: Quick Effect detaches 1 material to negate the activation of a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that includes Special Summoning and destroy it.

allow.D/D/D Wave High King Caesar: Rank 6 Fiend omni-negate for Special Summons and effects that Special Summon.
